description: This file defines a template class 'optional' similar to std::experimental::optional, providing optional value semantics with methods for construction, assignment, and access, along with related types and operators.

classes.name: optional
classes.description: A template class implementing optional value semantics, allowing an object to contain or not contain a value of type T.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Conversion operator to check if the optional contains a value.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Accesses the contained object via pointer.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences to access the contained object.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the contained object, with debug check.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two optional objects.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the optional to contain a new value, constructing it in place.

methods.name: EnsureDisengaged
methods.description: Destructs the contained object if engaged and marks optional as disengaged.
